_comment: Shared by activityChanges.test.ts and internal/cli/activity_changes_test.go (BUG-2789). Each case pins formatChangesForDisplay's output; both implementations must agree with it, so a rule changed in one language fails the other's test. The whitespace and length cases exist because JS \s/trim() and Go unicode.IsSpace disagree in both directions (U+0085, U+FEFF) and JS length counts UTF-16 units.
